description: A 3HP stereo attenuator that passes a left and a right signal through at the level set, with a VCA input for controlling that level from the patch

params.text: Scales both signals from silence at one end of its travel to full at the other

inputs.text: The voltage here divided by 10 multiplies the level, so 10V passes the signals at the level the knob sets and 0V silences them
The left signal to be attenuated
The right signal to be attenuated

menu: Exponential — gives the level knob a logarithmic taper, so the lower part of its travel changes the level more slowly
